title: deep-audit-dnd5e-srd default --out dir lives under tmpdir() (by design, not a leak)
description: Follow-up from eshyra-knh9.1 (per-run test temp root + script temp leaks). packages/core/scripts/deep-audit-dnd5e-srd/cli.ts defaults its --out report directory to mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'deep-audit-dnd5e-srd-')) when --out is not passed, and deliberately does NOT clean it up: the JSON reports it writes (deep-audit-findings.json, page-coverage-report.json) ARE the tool's deliverable, printed to the user as 'Reports: <dir>' for them to open afterward. This is correct behavior, not the leak bug eshyra-knh9.1 fixed elsewhere (verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts, generate-creature-name-baseline/cli.ts, doltProvision.ts, smoke-installer.mjs all had process.exit() bypassing a finally{} cleanup -- this script has no such bug). Optional low-priority DX nit: consider defaulting --out to a repo-local directory (e.g. ./deep-audit-reports/) instead of the OS temp dir, so a human running 'npm run audit:dnd5e-srd-deep' without --out doesn't have to dig through tmpdir() to find the reports, and so they don't eventually get swept by an unrelated tmpdir cleanup. Not part of any required gate (verify:worktree/test/CI never invoke this script).
